event_detail: No straw is in the gripper. The robot turns and moves along the island with its gripper closed, held level, and does not go to the glass cup on the island.
evidence: Wrist camera shows only the floor, the wall and an appliance, with the finger tips closed together and nothing between them. Shoulder views show the arm held out to the side, with no straw visible in the fingers. The small glass cup near the plant on the island stays far away and empty in all 4 frames, and the view rotates as the base moves. The 'drawer in front' is not clearly in view: the island drawers that are visible look closed, but stage 1 may have been done earlier out of view. I did not guess it as done.
